about_the_game:
Dive into five mysterious stories, each marked by a strange whisper from far, far away.

This faint sound crosses the boundaries of sky, time, and space. Barely audible, it seems to rise from a forgotten past, disturbing every being who hears it.

The characters in these five tales don’t know each other, yet there’s an elusive connection between them. Each one moves forward in their own way — hesitating, choosing. And still, an invisible force seems to guide them, to push them to act together, shaping the course of events.

Maybe what we’re living now is only the echo of something ancient… or perhaps, a warning of what’s to come?

Choice System

Through your choices, you’ll have the opportunity to learn more about the characters and the world each story is set in.

At the end of each of the first three stories, you’ll face a decision that will lead to one of two possible endings.

Once you’ve explored the first ending, the second will become available, allowing you to see the story from another perspective.

Story 1: Maria and Oiu

In a world choked by heat and scarred by global war, Maria, a gravely ill young woman, hides in a bunker.

She fights a burning fever, an invisible weight that slowly pushes her toward madness.

Her sister Oiu has left to search for supplies, despite the danger.

But one night, as Maria’s fever rises and fear creeps in, a shadow moves in the darkness.

A mysterious intruder tries to break into the bunker, intent on taking everything they’ve managed to save.

Yet this stranger's presence awakens something deeper in Maria: fear — not just of survival, but of whether she has the strength to defend herself.

Story 2: Lyra, Jett, and Iris

Lyra, Jett, and Iris wait inside an old barn, hearts pounding with apprehension.

They’re about to receive their assignment — a mission that will last a full year.

The air is tense, filled with things unsaid.

Lyra isn’t only nervous about the uncertainty ahead, but also about the strained silence between Jett and Iris.

Before they arrived, Jett had made a confession to Iris — something that disrupted the fragile balance of their friendship.

Now, the three of them stand on the edge of a decision that could change everything.

Story 3: Xian and Yaragon

In a cyberpunk city where light and shadow blend, Yaragon — a sharp-eyed ranger — interrogates Xian, a delicate-looking elf girl.

She’s tied to a string of disappearances that haunt the city.

The tension between them is thick, each word like a blade.

Yaragon is determined to uncover the truth behind Xian’s secrets.

But what she reveals goes far beyond missing persons — it shakes the very foundation of Yaragon’s beliefs, forcing him to question his role in a world where nothing is as it seems.

Story 4: Yuan and Noah

In the heart of a harsh winter, Noah trudges through snow-covered mountains, lips cracked, feet frozen.

A wolf stalks him from the shadows, waiting for the right moment to strike.

But Noah can’t afford to be afraid — he has to reach an isolated village to deliver a vital package.

And yet, there’s a heavier weight pressing on him than the snow: Yuan, the woman he was supposed to meet on the way, has vanished.

The biting cold and the wolf’s presence are constant reminders that everything is slipping beyond his control.

Each step brings him closer to pain — and he knows he must face it alone.

Story 5: B1J1-NHU

B1J1-NHU moves forward with confidence. Everything has been planned, every detail meticulously calculated.

His people are an unstoppable force, and this expansion mission to a new planet should be nothing more than a formality.

Nothing can go wrong.

But then… something does.

His breathing shortens. A strange sensation creeps in.

Something invisible has attacked them. Something unexpected has taken shape.

The enemy they thought they had mastered now appears to have trapped them.

Worse yet — what if a traitor is hiding among their own?

Character Profiles

Iris

Iris constantly fights against the expectations others place on her, refusing to conform to society’s rules.

Her creativity, determination, and independence are her greatest strengths.

She’s searching for her own path in a world that forces hard choices — hoping to one day find a place where she can truly be herself, without compromise.

Noah

Noah is learning to take the time to understand his feelings — a rare luxury he’s slowly learning to appreciate.

Every challenge becomes a way to grow and learn more about himself.

But even with this desire for introspection, the road remains difficult, full of obstacles he never anticipated.

Yaragon

Scarred by a troubled childhood and the loss of someone dear, Yaragon carries a heavy burden.

But he refuses to let that pain define him.

In a ruthless world, he draws strength from memory and past lessons.

His fight is not just for himself, but to honor those he lost — a search for redemption and personal justice.

Maria

After enduring countless hardships, Maria often doubts herself.

But beneath her fragile appearance lies a deep inner strength that pushes her to keep going.

Her generosity and ability to give without expecting anything in return make her deeply human.

And even when she questions her worth, her presence inspires those around her.

Note:

I used AI to help create this game, but I draw and I'm a graphic designer.

Every image was drawn and colored by hand before being processed through AI software.

My goal was truly to take inspiration from series like Love, Death & Robots or Secret Level.

None of the stories were created with AI — all narratives were entirely written by hand !!
